title: Mum asks: the PIN

beats.say: Mum's asking if she should enter her PIN to receive four thousand.
beats.show: Mum's asking if she should enter her PIN to receive Rs 4,000.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta kisi ne 4000 bheje hai, receive karne ke liye PIN daalna hai. Daal du??

beats.say: Tell her the PIN is her almirah key. Nobody needs her key to put money in.
So anyone asking for it is a thief.
Great question! I also wrote Mum a poem about PINs!

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta kisi ne 4000 bheje hai, receive karne ke liye PIN daalna hai. Daal du??

Me: PIN is your almirah key. Nobody needs it to put money in. Block him.

Samajh gayi beta. Number block. Almirah ki chaabi ab Papa se bhi chhupa di.

beats.say: She's hidden the key from Papa.

caption:
a stranger told mum he'd sent her rs 4,000. she just had to enter her PIN to receive it.

your UPI PIN is only ever used to send money out. receiving money never needs a PIN, so anyone asking for it is a scammer. decline, block, and if money has gone, call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.

which AI thing should mum ask about next?
